resources.string: Jobs are processed by WorkManager (ADR-010). Once queued, a job advances through QUEUED → PREPARING → RENDERING → ENCODING → VERIFYING → PUBLISHING → COMPLETE as a two-phase commit, so partial output is never treated as complete.

Note: only the 9 whitelisted EXIF capture tags are written back (Make/Model/LensModel/DateTime/DateTimeOriginal/FNumber/ISO/FocalLength/ExposureTime; orientation is always 1 and GPS/location is never written). RAW/TIFF export is not supported. For HDR sources the export either passes the gainmap through or writes SDR only, depending on the edits, and the reason for that choice is recorded in the request file. Job settings live in the request file under the cache directory, so clearing the cache makes jobs FAILED_PERMANENT (they must be configured again).
